# Attainment is a ratio of two choices

`customer_support.mm.sla_management.attainment_is_a_ratio_of_two_choices` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Attainment is not a measurement of speed. It is a ratio between how fast we were and how slow we promised to be, and both terms are editable.

This is why attainment across teams or vendors is close to meaningless without the targets and the pause rules alongside it, and why a team under pressure will always find it easier to edit the denominator than the numerator.
